correctness.rationale: For the stipulated symmetric linear model, the subspace of zero-sum ordinary entries with zero hub entry is invariant under Phi, and the middle diagonal operator is the identity there. Hence the restriction is beta_0 B² minus gamma I, and by symmetry the orthogonal projection to that subspace commutes with the generator, giving autonomy for arbitrary initial perturbations. The nonnegative constant-row-sum block has all eigenvalues in [-(1-q),1-q], and symmetry gives the exact Euclidean semigroup norm from the largest squared transverse eigenvalue. The stated interpolation is admissible and spans the full interval. The positive reduced Perron eigenvector lifts to a positive full eigenvector, including at q=1/m; the common-value/hub quotient therefore gives the full reproduction number. The exact frozen example has quotient eigenvalues 0 and 4/3 and contrast exponents 1 and 5/8.
residual_risks: The result concerns the supplied disease-free linear matrix only. No nonlinear homogenization or empirical prediction follows.
